title: Ethiopia blames Egypt, Eritrea for Tigray attacks
html:
Ethiopia blames Egypt, Eritrea for Tigray attacks

Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of leading a military offensive involving the TPLF in the Tigray region, with Egypt providing logistical support and supplies. Its army chief said Ethiopian forces repelled the attacks, and retreating TPLF leaders fled to Eritrea.
summary: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of leading TPLF attacks in Tigray, with Egypt providing logistical support.
